title: Integral support comparison for a fixed finite realization
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(D.k)$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $D.k$-schemes and fix a compactification $c$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix reduction/limit calculi $S_X,S_Z,S_Y$ and any finite-operation realization $r$ with system compact-support functor $\mathcal F_r$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-sf-finite-adjunction-diagram-data, def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. On $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the literal ambient functor $\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_r\mathcal R_X$ of [lem-coef-integral-exceptional-mapping-system] is naturally isomorphic to the recorded integral compact-support functor for $c$ followed by inclusion in the ambient derived category [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. No exceptional preservation or integral adjunction is asserted.

source.place: Accepted specified-adjunction interface: literal compact-support identification; uniqueness-of-adjoints transfer from lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization.

proof.text: Choose a geometric finite-operation realization r0 with IntegralSupport using lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization. The reduction functors for the arbitrary calculus and r0 are left adjoints of the same total limit, hence are naturally isomorphic. The system open extensions are left adjoints of the same geometric system pullback and the proper images are right adjoints of the same pullback, so uniqueness of adjoints gives whole-system natural isomorphisms of the two support composites.

Whisker the actual supportIso for the arbitrary realization and r0 with reduction and total limit. Insert the reduction and support-composite isomorphisms to identify F_r with F_r0. Compose with IntegralSupport.iso for r0. The proof witnesses for restricted reductions are propositions and are identified by proof irrelevance. No map or equality is inferred merely from finite evaluations.
